original_goal: Calibrated primordial atomic/nuclear kinetics and thermal evolution with baryonic anisotropic pressure and consistent metric/source feedback.
current_unit: Derive and implement incoming binary reactive loss moments, common-bulk/common-T linear Grad STF; finite-domain source moments; conservative resolved event/source interface.
not_completed_by_this_unit: Physical source-qualified D/He/Li full CI/DR/CX coverage

conventions.rate_kernel: K(g)=g sigma(g), independent of T; alpha=<K>, beta=<E_rel K>, gamma=<E_rel^2 K>
conventions.reaction_pair: two distinct species, no identical-particle symmetry factor assumed
conventions.kinematics: common bulk rest frame and common Maxwellian T; finite masses; linear first variation in each STF pressure
conventions.grad_warning: finite Grad polynomial is not globally positive; derivatives are infinitesimal, not a realizability-certified finite-anisotropy trajectory
conventions.stress_ownership: existing matter is nonbaryonic; HE32 gas pi_b=0 unchanged
conventions.nuclear_source: R_part includes changes in nuclei count and free-electron count; all energy reservoirs supplied explicitly

source_scope.CCC: 87-row H1 electron-impact total ionization table, incident lab energy13.6058..968.61eV, sigma in a0^2, positive piecewise-linear interpolation. Actual-data diagnostic uses heavy stationary target (energy mass electron).
source_scope.partial_moments: Only finite tabulated energy support. No extrapolated tail, no physical truncation/interpolation error bound.
source_scope.finite_mass_source: Generic theoretical kernel uses relative energy mu*g^2/2. Actual CCC lab-energy coordinate is NOT silently relabeled as relative energy.
source_scope.rate_derivatives: Moment ladder only for T-independent microscopic K and legal derivative/integral exchange; derivative of an empirical rate fit is not an independently validated cross-section moment.
source_scope.event_birth: Resolved supplied momentum/second moment needed; isotropic photons do not force anisotropic parent-removal J to vanish.

acceptance.symbolic: independent derivation and exact polynomial/CAS identities; preserve failed tool attempts
acceptance.finite_mass: independent Cartesian Gaussian quadrature at polynomial kernels; relative residual <=2e-11 on dimensionless controls
acceptance.finite_source: positiveGL16 shared moment calculation vs GL32 and independently adaptive finite-bin integral <=2e-9 relative for each moment at selected T in2000..200000K
acceptance.moment_feasibility: alpha>=0, beta>=0, gamma>=0 and alpha*gamma>=beta^2 with normalized roundoff allowance; no silent repair
acceptance.event_ledger: exact integer baryon/charge conservation, declared number source, energy owner sum and frame conversion; unknown product tensors raise explicit missing input
acceptance.reproducibility: immutable input/code hashes, commands/environment/exit/resources, actual PNG inspection, two handoffs
acceptance.publication: each R1-R10/C1-C10 gets Git commit plus separate Dropbox checkpoint with actual ACK; final unit archive and readback

execution_budget.new_work: bounded algebra/quadrature/finite source controls; only novel scopes
execution_budget.resource_policy: binary64; no fastmath; measured cost only; do not claim native rewrite speedup
